title: Refactoring a Growing Vue App (Guided)
objectives: Recognize the smells of an oversized component
Extract API access into services step by step

examples.name: extract.ts

exercise.prompt: Order the refactor steps: "extract api calls to a service", "write characterization tests", "extract display into child components", "move state to a store" into a safe sequence.
hints: You cannot refactor safely without tests pinning current behavior.
State moves after I/O extraction — smaller steps, safer reviews.

questions.prompt: The first step when refactoring a legacy component is…
questions.explanation: Characterization tests make the refactor verifiable; everything else follows.

options: mixed responsibilities: I/O, state, and rendering in one place
questions.explanation: Size itself is a symptom — the fix is separating the responsibilities it conflates.
